headline: Goa Launches 'Mhajo Flat' Scheme for Unregistered Properties
summary: The Goa government has introduced the 'Mhajo Flat' scheme aimed at helping residents regularize unregistered housing units across the state. This initiative provides flat owners an opportunity to secure official ownership documentation.

headline: Goa Permits 24/7 Operations for Malls and Commercial Outlets
summary: Commercial establishments, shops, and shopping malls in Goa can now operate round-the-clock following a new government directive. The decision aims to boost economic activity and cater to nightlife and tourism demand.

headline: Goa Government Targets 100 Flats for Affordable Housing Push
summary: The state government is aiming to acquire 100 flats to expand its affordable housing initiative. The push seeks to provide budget-friendly residential options for local residents.

headline: IFFI 2026 to Screen Over 230 Films with Spain as Country of Honour
summary: The International Film Festival of India 2026 in Goa will showcase more than 230 movies from around the globe. Spain has been chosen as the Country of Honour for this edition of the prestigious event.

headline: 'Ancessao' Chosen as Opening Feature for Goan Film Section at IFFI
summary: The movie 'Ancessao' has been selected to premiere as the opening film in the Goan Film Section at the International Film Festival of India. The section highlights local cinematic talent and storytelling.

headline: Traffic and Parking Plan Announced for IFFI 2026 in Goa
summary: Authorities in Goa have issued special traffic diversions and designated parking arrangements to handle congestion during IFFI 2026. The measures aim to ensure smooth movement for event attendees and local commuters.

headline: Senior Citizens Applaud New Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express
summary: Elderly travelers are praising the newly launched Bengaluru to Goa Vande Bharat Express for its comfortable seating and modern accessibility features. The service offers a smoother travel experience through scenic routes.

headline: Family Completes 2,200 km Road Trip from Mumbai to Goa and Udupi
summary: A family successfully journeyed across 2,200 kilometers in a Mitsubishi Cedia, driving along the coastal route from Mumbai to Goa and Udupi. The travelogue highlights road conditions and coastal travel experiences.

headline: Voter Registrations Increase in Goa in Latest Draft Electoral Rolls
summary: The draft electoral rolls under the Special Summary Revision show a rise in registered voters in Goa, Uttarakhand, and Manipur. Punjab's overall voter count remained unchanged during the update.

headline: Proposed Turtle Nesting Sites Spark Livelihood Concerns in Goa
summary: Local coastal stakeholders and fishermen in Goa have expressed worry over a plan to declare new turtle nesting beaches. They fear environmental restrictions could negatively impact their daily earnings and tourism businesses.

headline: Goa Teacher Booked Under POCSO for Stalking Minor Student
summary: Goa Police have registered a case under the POCSO Act against a school teacher for reportedly stalking and harassing a minor student. Investigations into the teacher's conduct are currently underway.

headline: NH-66 Coastal Highway Enhances Connectivity and Growth in Goa
summary: Upgrades along the NH-66 highway pass through Goa's picturesque coast, linking key regions and improving regional travel. The infrastructure project aims to spur local economic development while preserving scenic appeal.

headline: Royal Enfield Expected to Unveil Himalayan 750 at Motoverse in Goa
summary: Motorcycle manufacturer Royal Enfield is expected to launch its anticipated Himalayan 750 bike during the upcoming Motoverse festival in Goa. The event will gather thousands of biking enthusiasts from across the country.

headline: Man Sentenced to 12 Years for 2018 Palolem Assault on British Tourist
summary: A court in Goa sentenced a man from Chennai to 12 years in prison for raping a British tourist in Palolem back in 2018. The verdict brings closure to a high-profile criminal case involving coastal safety.

headline: Road Safety Issues Raised Near Peddem Sports Complex
summary: Residents and visitors have flagged safety hazards along the approach road to the Peddem Sports Complex due to poor infrastructure. Demands have been made for prompt repairs and better traffic management.

headline: Panaji Mobility Plan Delayed Amid Growing Road Congestion
summary: Implementation of Panaji's urban mobility plan remains stalled while the capital city continues to struggle with traffic bottlenecks and parking shortages. Citizens are urging speedy execution of traffic solutions.

headline: Illicit Goa Liquor Worth ₹55 Lakh Seized Near Border
summary: Law enforcement officers confiscated illegal Goa-made alcohol valued at ₹55 lakh near the state border during a routine check. The vehicle driver fled the scene and authorities are tracking down suspect links.

headline: Police Arrest Bicholim Teacher for Harassing Minor Student
summary: A school teacher in Bicholim was arrested by Goa Police following complaints of stalking and harassing a minor female student. Legal action has been initiated under protection laws.

headline: Goa Forward Party to Focus Solely on Winnable Seats, Says Vijai
summary: Goa Forward Party chief Vijai Sardesai announced that his party will strategically claim only seats where it has strong winning prospects in upcoming elections. He emphasized coalition unity and selective candidate placement.

headline: Goa Retail Inflation Hits 15-Month High of 4.58% in October
summary: Official data reveals that Goa's retail inflation surged to 4.58% in October, marking its highest rate in 15 months. The rise was largely driven by increased prices for essential food items and consumer goods.

headline: New Vande Bharat Express to Connect Bengaluru and Madgaon in 13 Hours
summary: The new Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express promises a fast 13-hour train journey linking Karnataka's capital to Goa's coast. The route enhances inter-state travel and rail connectivity for tourists.

headline: 'Mhajo Flat' Scheme Launched to Regularize Unregistered Goa Apartments
summary: The Goa state government launched the 'Mhajo Flat' initiative to allow apartment owners with unrecorded titles to obtain legal recognition. The initiative simplifies registration processes across urban and rural developments.

headline: Second Child Abuse FIR Filed Against North Goa Schoolteacher
summary: Police have registered another case involving child abuse against a schoolteacher in North Goa over accusations of stalking and sexual misconduct. Educational authorities are conducting an internal investigation alongside police action.

headline: Goa Approves 24/7 Operations for Malls and Retail Stores
summary: State authorities have officially permitted retail stores, malls, and commercial establishments in Goa to stay open 24 hours a day. The move is designed to boost commerce and offer greater flexibility to shoppers and tourists.

headline: 10 Films Selected to Compete for ICFT-UNESCO Gandhi Medal at IFFI
summary: Ten international movies have been nominated to compete for the prestigious ICFT-UNESCO Gandhi Medal at the upcoming 57th IFFI in Goa. The award honors films promoting peace, tolerance, and non-violence.

headline: Goa Government to Offer AI Training for Students and Job Seekers
summary: The Goa state administration has launched a skill development initiative to train students, job seekers, and working professionals in Artificial Intelligence. The program aims to bridge the digital skills gap and enhance employability.

headline: Social Entrepreneurship Gains Traction in Goa's Local Economy
summary: Socially responsible business models are emerging across Goa, focusing on community development and sustainable environmental practices. Local entrepreneurs are driving positive societal change through innovative ventures.

headline: Mandrem and Galgibaga Beaches Nominated for Blue Flag Certification
summary: Goa's Mandrem and Galgibaga beaches are slated to receive the coveted international Blue Flag certification for the 2026-27 season. The recognition highlights clean coastlines, eco-friendly infrastructure, and visitor safety.

headline: Delays in Constituting District Planning Committees Halt Local Projects
summary: District planning activities in Goa have hit a standstill due to delays in constituting the District Planning Committees. Local governance representatives are demanding immediate appointment of members to resume development work.

headline: Palolem Tourism Operators Threaten Protest Against Beach Protection Plan
summary: Shack owners and tourism operators in Palolem are threatening to protest against a proposed government beach protection scheme. They argue that structural measures could harm natural beach landscapes and disrupt tourism activities.

headline: New Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Features Rotating Seats and Scenic Views
summary: Passengers on the new Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express can enjoy 180-degree rotating seats designed for viewing the picturesque Western Ghats landscape. The train offers modern amenities for scenic rail journeys.

headline: Goa Forest Department Proposes 24 Beaches as Protected Turtle Nesting Sites
summary: The Forest Department has proposed designating 24 beaches across Goa as official sea turtle nesting zones. The measure aims to strengthen marine conservation and protect endangered olive ridley turtles.

headline: Canacona Residents Oppose Proposal to Designate Entire Coast as Turtle Site
summary: Tensions have flared in Canacona over a government plan to classify its full coastline as a turtle nesting habitat. Local business owners and residents fear stringent environmental laws will paralyze coastal livelihoods.

headline: Daman Drops Kalyan Chaubey as Voting Delegate for AIFF Elections
summary: The Daman football association has removed Kalyan Chaubey as its representative delegate for the upcoming All India Football Federation elections. The move shifts voting dynamics in the national sports body.

headline: Six Unhurt as KSRTC Bus Veers Off Road in Canacona
summary: Six passengers had a narrow escape when a Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation bus lost control and ran off the road in Canacona. No major injuries were reported, and emergency teams cleared the vehicle.

headline: Goa Prepares to Host 57th International Film Festival of India
summary: Preparations are in full swing as Goa gears up to host the 57th edition of the International Film Festival of India. Delegates, filmmakers, and movie enthusiasts from around the world are expected to attend.

headline: Escalating Living Costs and Inflation Impact Households in Goa
summary: Residents across Goa are feeling the strain of rising prices on essential commodities, food, and energy services. Economists point to broader supply chain shifts and regional price increases as key drivers.

headline: KTC Issues Notice to Mapusa Bus Stand Parking Operator for Overcharging
summary: Kadamba Transport Corporation has slapped a formal notice on the parking contractor at Mapusa bus stand after multiple complaints of overcharging. Authorities warned of contract termination if violations persist.

headline: Veteran Journalists Honored at State-Level Ceremony in Goa
summary: Prominent senior journalists were felicitated for their contributions to media and public reporting during a state-level event held in Goa. Government officials praised their role in upholding democratic accountability.

headline: Police Uncover Multiple Motives in Porvorim Casino Shootout Investigation
summary: Goa Police investigating the violent casino shootout in Porvorim have discovered multiple rival motives, including business disputes and personal grudges. Several suspects remain in custody for further questioning.

headline: Tourist Alleges Overcharging at Mapusa Bus Stand Parking Area
summary: A visitor to Mapusa was forced to pay double the official parking fee at the KTC bus terminal, sparking renewed calls for strict enforcement. Local authorities promised action against non-compliant parking operators.

headline: Two Passengers Detained for Consuming Unfiltered Alcohol on Goa Flight
summary: Flight crew handed over two unruly passengers to security forces upon arrival in Goa after they were caught consuming private alcohol inflight. Airline officials reiterated zero tolerance for safety violations onboard.

headline: Goa Food Safety Team Raids Unlicensed Poultry Supplier
summary: State Food Safety officers conducted a raid on an illegal chicken supplier operating without required health permits in Goa. Stock was confiscated and legal proceedings initiated against the vendor.

headline: Canacona Farmers Request Relief as Wild Animals Damage Crops
summary: Agricultural communities in Canacona are reporting severe crop losses due to frequent attacks by wild animals on local farms. Farmers are requesting state compensation and protective fencing support from authorities.

headline: Demands Grow for Rehabilitation of Evacuated Borda Building Residents
summary: Demands are mounting for the immediate rehabilitation of families evicted from an unsafe residential building in Borda. Local representatives are pressing officials to provide long-term housing solutions.

headline: Congress and Goa Forward Party Open Alliance Talks for 2027 Elections
summary: Leaders from the Congress party and Goa Forward Party have commenced preliminary talks to form an electoral alliance for the 2027 Goa Assembly elections. Both parties aim to consolidate opposition votes.

headline: Violent Incident in Seraulim Sparks Fears of Gang Rivalry
summary: A recent assault in Seraulim has raised concerns among local residents and police regarding potential gang rivalries in South Goa. Security patrols have been heightened across key hotspots.

headline: Prudent Media Wins Top Honors at Goa State Journalism Awards
summary: Local news channel Prudent Media dominated the Goa State Journalism Awards, securing multiple honors across reporting and broadcast categories. The ceremony recognized excellence in journalism across the state.

headline: Vasco's Swatantra Path Road Revamp Scheduled for Completion by Late December
summary: Urban beautification and infrastructure upgrades along Vasco's main Swatantra Path artery are slated for completion by the end of December. The project includes improved footpaths, lighting, and road resurfacing.

headline: Experts Call for Sustainable Water Strategy to Secure India's Future
summary: Environmental policy experts are calling for comprehensive water management strategies to combat rising scarcity across India. The proposal highlights rainwater harvesting, river restoration, and efficient agricultural water use.
